resources.string: These optional settings record a requested evaluation configuration. A score threshold and requested gate do not supply a measured result, enforce a gate or establish quality or safety.
Supply an exact JSON number. The contract sets no score range, unit, percentage scale or recommended threshold.
Supply an exact whole number, at least 1. This is a configured size, not a verified dataset count.
Not supplied, false and true are distinct. This requests a gate; it does not enforce one or change whether this component is enabled.
Enter a value or clear the supply option.
Enter an exact JSON number without grouping or locale separators.
Enter an exact JSON whole number without grouping or locale separators.
This input exceeds the local editor limit.
Pending input is retained only within the local recovery limit and requires explicit review. Recovering input does not confirm a save or authorize an evaluation.
